notes.title: v4.0.2 update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Bug fixes and changes

 Fixed an issue in the level Basement where the clown entity wasn't able to move at all.
 Added a checkpoint when you completed a certain objective in the KaleidoMode.

Notes: If you REALLY want to break the horror aspects of this game, change the jumpscare mp4 file to something your heart desires (make sure you name the mp4 file the same way it is in the original file). Have fun :3

notes.title: v4.0.1 update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Changes

KaleidoMode
 The button will now always be visible regardless if you have the ability to play it, or not.
 Made changes on how you unlock the ability to play the KaleidoMode (Hint: You unlock it by getting the true/good ending)

Notes: If you REALLY want to break the horror aspects of this game, change the jumpscare mp4 file to something your heart desires (make sure you name the mp4 file the same way it is in the original file). Have fun :3

notes.title: The Horror Story: Rebirth Update (v4.0.0)
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/HqBbq5tbLa0

Changes

 Added a new linear DLC expansion. The KaleidoMode is a free DLC that unlocks once you completed the base game by getting the good, or bad ending.
 Moved a couple of UI elements in the main menu.
 Added Nanite, and Lumen into the game.
 Added new settings to adjust on the settings menu in case your PC, or Steam Deck has a hard time getting a stable framerate.
 Made changes to where "Bonus 2" now takes you to where tape 3 teleports you at.

notes.title: The Horror Story update released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Added a hint in Basement for anyone to learn the basics of the game. If you need to see the controls again, you can always go to the settings menu at anytime.

notes.title: The Horror Story update released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

An update for The Horror Story has been released.

Side Game Mode

Featuring 5 new levels:
- Double Trouble Basement
- TheGhosTaco Bush Maze (What?)
- Chaos Maze
- Race Against The Clown
- Race Against The Clowns

Patch Notes

- Adjust the first Bonus level to let the players know that they are indeed in the level, and not soft locked (some people do forget they have a flashlight.)
